newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Playboy repeated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Playboy repeated as buy.

text.p: Gruntal & Co Inc analyst Rita Zanella on Wednesday reiterated a buy recommendation on Playboy Enterprises Inc, citing the company's launch of two television networks in Latin America.
In a joint effort with Cisneros Television Group, Playboy will hold a 19 percent interest in Playboy TV Latin America LLC, with an option to buy up to an additional 30 percent.

Zanella said the Latin American move had "the potential to be the largest international network for the company in terms of households reached. We continue to recommend purchase of Playboy shares with a price target of $18."
